text:
mira: quick pitch we should implement a Gradual Admit Controller for dedicated GPU pools. gist: tune admit_rate for prewarm gradually instead of abrupt drains to reduce churn.

sam: agree. what signals? inflight rate + p95 + gpu util mix?

mira: yes, weighted composite. target_headroom_pct and smoothing_tau control behavior.

oliver: operator/control-plane split? control-plane decides rates, operator enforces. hybrid seems best.

kai: need protected leases for long warmup models and tenant TTLs for cron jobs. also enterprise opt-out.

mira: fallback plan: small preemptible emergency pool + abort taper if headroom < 3% and latency spikes.

ops-bot: checklist: feature-flag `gradual_admit`, add telemetry admit_rate, idle_reclaims, emergency_refills, update operator RBAC.

sam: test plan: synthetic diurnal bursts + cron noise; measure cold-starts, p95, cost delta; include chaos.

mira: action items: prototype controller (me), telemetry/tests (sam), operator proto + RBAC (oliver), enterprise UX (kai). RFC tomorrow.
